plainTranslation: Their Mars in your 7th house: they pursue partnership with you directly - drive toward commitment, or toward conflict, since the 7th rules open enemies too. Failure mode: the relationship runs hot with arguments. Fight fair; aim the drive at building the partnership.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry house overlay material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
